name: Puebla de la Calzada (Spain)
description: Light blue field with three narrow vertical stripes at the hoist, red, green and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Puebla de la Calzada (a bridge, a cross of Saint James and waves).
history: Municipal flag of Puebla de la Calzada; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Puebla de la Calzada arms — bridge, cross of Saint James and waves
